sources.note: Official municipal page opened; 24-hour emergency service for injured street animals, phone 1950 ext. 5000. Not a clinic list.

sources.note: Own pages opened for Laika, Veterinaria Centenario, Veterinaria Capurro, Veterinaria Pocitos, Puntovet, MIVET; 24 h only where the page says so.

sources.name: Lead lists (leads only)

entries.name: Laika Urgencias 24 h
entries.duty: Emergency service available 24 hours; call the emergency line.
entries.note: Page: 'Urgencias 24hs', 'Llamanos las 24 horas', FAQ 'urgencias 24 horas en Montevideo'. No branch address on the page (links to sucursales.laika.com.uy, not opened). General WhatsApp 095 909 955.

entries.name: Veterinaria Centenario
entries.duty: Emergency home visits 24 hours; regular hours Tuesday to Sunday 9:00-16:00.
entries.note: Page: 'Servicio de Urgencias a domicilio y Atencion en Clinica las 24 hs'. Landlines 2622 8012 / 2628 2697. Re-check 2026-11-11: the page confirms only the 24 h home emergency service; in-clinic 24 h not reconfirmed.

entries.name: Veterinaria Capurro
entries.duty: Emergency service 24 hours; regular hours Monday to Saturday 9:00-20:00.
entries.note: Page: 'Contamos con servicio de urgencias 24 horas'; does not say which branch. Second branch Villa del Cerro: Grecia 4002 esq. Belgica, phone 098 104 002.

entries.name: Veterinaria Pocitos
entries.duty: Emergency line 24 hours; clinic hours Monday to Friday 10:00-20:00, Saturday 10:00-15:00.
entries.note: Page lists 'Urgencias 24 horas' 091 40 41 41. Clinic phones 2709 68 05 and 099 26 86 20. Same 091 404 141 number is used by the MIVET page for its member emergency service.

entries.name: MIVET Clinica Veterinaria
entries.duty: Open daily 9:00-21:00; 24-hour emergency home visits (fee applies, call 091 404 141 and say you are a Veterinaria Lacucha member).
entries.note: Page: 'Lo atenderan las 24 horas a domicilio'; visit $1,200 UYU plus medication. Mobile 092 354 651. Only the product page was opened, not the home page.

entries.name: Puntovet Montevideo
entries.duty: Emergency service 24 hours, 365 days a year; store hours Monday to Friday 9:00-20:00, Saturday 10:00-20:00, Sunday 12:00-20:00.
entries.note: Page: 'Contamos con servicio de emergencia las 24 horas, los 365 dias de ano'; the site presents as a pet store/pharmacy and links to a Clinicas page (not opened), so the clinic nature is unverified. Emergency number is the Montevideo line; general 092 975 774.

entries.name: Puntovet Salto (emergency line)
entries.duty: Emergency service 24 hours, 365 days a year (call the emergency line).
entries.note: Salto emergency number from the same Puntovet emergency page; no Salto address on that page.

entries.name: Puntovet Canelones (emergency line)
entries.duty: Emergency service 24 hours, 365 days a year (call the emergency line).
entries.note: Canelones emergency number from the same Puntovet emergency page; no address on that page.

entries.name: Clinica Veterinaria Lopez Quintana
entries.duty: Emergencies and hospitalisation 24 hours, 7 days a week; consultations Monday to Friday 9:30-19:00, Saturday 9:00-14:00.
entries.note: Phone is the 'Urgencias (24 horas)' line; consultations WhatsApp 091 929 271, administration 092 426 638.

entries.name: Veterinaria La Pastora
entries.address: Av. Italia esq. Rimas, Punta del Este
entries.duty: Monday to Saturday 10:00-19:00; Sunday emergencies only. Emergency line (calls only), call ahead.
entries.note: Page never says 24 h. Clinic landline 42 49 5599; consultations WhatsApp 098 924 066.

entries.name: Veterinaria Perro Verde
entries.duty: Emergencies available 24 hours, 7 days a week; regular hours Monday to Friday 8:30-12:30 and 15:00-18:00, Saturday 16:00-18:00.
entries.note: Page: 'Disponibilidad las veinticuatro horas del dia, los 7 dias de la semana' with emergency mobile 091 510 101. General contact 091 221 368.

entries.name: Veterinaria Fraschini (Young)
entries.duty: Small-animal clinic with an emergency line; Monday to Friday 7:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, Saturday 7:00-12:00; call ahead.
entries.note: Page lists 'Clinica y Urgencias: 091 070 439' but no 24 h claim. Other phone 099 56 08 90.

entries.name: Veterinaria Fraschini (Paysandu)
entries.duty: Monday to Friday 7:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:30, Saturday 7:00-12:00 (summer afternoon hours shift slightly).
entries.note: Casa Central; page does not say whether it treats small animals (general veterinaria). Mobile 099 71 95 26.

entries.name: Centro Medico Veterinario Paysandu
entries.note: Contact page has no hours and no emergency/24 h mention. WhatsApp +598 98 306 294.

entries.name: Veterinaria Itapebi
entries.address: Av. Franklin D. Roosevelt 461, Colonia del Sacramento
entries.duty: Monday to Friday 9:00-13:00 and 15:00-19:00, Saturday 9:00-13:00; no emergency service stated, call ahead.
entries.note: Page has no emergency/24 h mention.

entries.name: Servicio de Emergencia Veterinaria - Intendencia de Montevideo
entries.duty: Municipal 24-hour emergency service for animals injured on public roads and for wild or exotic animals; not a general clinic. WhatsApp 099 019 500 daily 6:00-24:00.
entries.note: Official page: 'las 24 horas del dia'; line 1950 ext. 5000. Aimed at street accidents and families without means; the owner takes responsibility for the animal afterwards. Address is the IM head office from the page.

notes: Uruguay: Montevideo, Maldonado/Punta del Este, Paysandu, Colonia and Young covered partially. No national duty rota, no SMVU/MGAP clinic directory and no animal poison line found: the SMVU (smvu.org.uy) and Facultad de Veterinaria (fvet.edu.uy) home pages could not be opened by the fetch tool (not in the allowed URL set); the faculty Memoria 2023 PDF has no hospital hours or phone; CIAT (human poison centre) was not confirmed to take animal calls. Not done / not reachable: Espacio Animal Montevideo (espacioanimal.uy, anti-bot page, only a search title says 'emergency service'), Hospital Veterinario HV (hvhospitalveterinario.com, anti-bot page), Laika branch addresses (sucursales.laika.com.uy not opened), Puntovet Clinicas page, Veterinarios en Accion (vea.com.uy, redirect loop), Centro Veterinario Salto (only Instagram, robots-blocked), Hospital de Paysandu and other veterinariasuruguay.com pages (robots-blocked), lacosta.com.uy (error), BuenVet, AsistVet, Veterinaria Cavia, Hospital Veterinario de la Costa, Vita Consultorio (Las Piedras), Veterinaria Nan, Clinica Veterinaria Uruguay (Paysandu), La Colonial, Salud Animal and Dr. Sebastian Vazquez (Colonia) - no own site opened. Not covered: Rocha / La Paloma / Punta del Diablo, Piriapolis, Rivera, Tacuarembo, Durazno, Florida, Minas, Mercedes, Carmelo, Ciudad de la Costa, Pando, Las Piedras (no own-site pages found).
